title: Positive powers of a Bernoulli bit
statement: Let $q\in[0,1]$ and let $m$ be a positive natural number. If a Bernoulli bit is $1$ with probability $q$ and $0$ with probability $1-q$, then the expectation of the $m$-th power of the bit equals $q$.
